name: branding-fashion-store-sign-app-and-web-blue-gradient-board
title: Blue-violet gradient sign, app screen and web hero for a fashion store
whatItIs: A board with a tilted navy-violet gradient wall sign carrying 'off-white' in bold italic white, a phone product page over a dark suited figure, and a blue-gradient web page with 'EVERY CLICK HERE MAKES IT STYLISH' and model tiles.
whatItMeans: Confident and modern; one blue gradient runs from street signage to screen.
techniques: Use the same gradient on sign, app and web.
Set the wordmark in italic bold.

vocabulary.definition: A brand built on a signature gradient.
A wall-mounted sign that sticks out.
A logo set in slanted type.
A presentation showing physical and digital use.
